newsitem.title: FINLAND: Enso signs FIM 1.5 bln corp note facility.
newsitem.headline: Enso signs FIM 1.5 bln corp note facility.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Enso Oy said in a statement on Friday it had signed a 1.50 billion markka corporate note facility for short-term financing needs.
The new programme will replace Enso's similar existing 1.00 billion markka scheme.
"Within the framework of the facility Enso can raise short-term financing by issuing markka-denominated bearer notes with maturity of up to one year," Enso said.

Merita Bank is lead manager of the facility and other banks participating are OKOBANK (Osuuspankkien Keskuspankki Oy), Postipankki Oy, Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken Ab Helsinki branch, Svenska Handelsbanken AB Helsinki and Den Danske Bank Helsinki, it said.
